item.title: EU AI Act Compliance: What AI Engineering Teams Should Monitor
item.description:
Date: December 22, 2025
Tags: ["EU AI Regulation", "AI Compliance", "Risk Management", "AI Engineering", "Data Governance"]
Summary:
  • The EU AI Act is now in force as of August 2024.
  • It imposes phased obligations on AI systems and providers.
  • Compliance requires engineering and product teams to implement safeguards.
  • Risk management and transparency are key compliance areas.
  • Legal teams set rules; engineers make them operational.
  • Monitoring and data governance are essential ongoing tasks.

item.title: From Noise to Signal: How Cohere Rerank-4 Improves RAG
item.description:
Author: Ewa Szyszka
Date: December 19, 2025
Tags: ["Retrieval-Augmented Generation", "Natural Language Processing", "Machine Learning Models", "Information Retrieval", "AI Model Optimization"]
Summary:
  • RAG pipelines often retrieve relevant but noisy documents.
  • Cohere Rerank-4 is a cross-encoder reranker that improves retrieval quality.
  • It captures deeper semantic relationships than bi-encoders.
  • RAGAS evaluation showed perfect relevance scores with Cohere Rerank-4.
  • The article explains integration and practical usage of this reranker.
  • This improves precision and accuracy in AI-generated answers.

item.title: Agent Security 101
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: December 23, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "AI Security", "Enterprise Technology", "Autonomous Systems", "Machine Learning"]
Summary:
  • LLMs have driven recent AI adoption in enterprises.
  • AI agents represent a major shift beyond static LLMs.
  • Agents operate autonomously with planning and memory.
  • This autonomy introduces new and complex security risks.
  • Securing AI agents is critical for safe enterprise deployment.
  • The article outlines agent components and security challenges.
